notes.title: Various Fixes
notes.notes:
-Rage Mana regeneration has been accelerated.

-Font Change Made in Item Info Texts.

-Fixed Item Disappearance Problem in Multiple Item Upgrade Panel.

-General HUD Screen Arrangements Made.

-Inventory Warning Logs Increased.

notes.title: Rage Fixes
notes.notes:
-Rage Creatures' Health Increased.
-Rage Creatures' Attack Increased.
-Rage Level Bonuses Reduced.
-Rage Login Upgrade Rates Reduced.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE RAGE SECTION ADDED!
notes.notes:
- Added Rage Section! In order to enter Rage, you go to the Rage Section with some Dungeon Keys and Coins, and by defeating the tough enemies there, you can collect Rage Points and have unique items.

- Added new music special to Rage section.

- The problem of not showing the number of items put in the inventory has been largely fixed.

- Minor changes have been made to the interface.

- Fonts have been improved.

- Added new rules for incorrect appearance in naming the character.

- Added new voice alerts and Logs.

notes.title: Font Update and Some Fixes
notes.notes:
-Some fonts in the game have been changed.
-If you double-click the item to be purchased from the Market with the left mouse click, it is automatically placed in the items to be purchased slot.
-The maximum number of select buttons has been added to the Upgrade Scroll receiving screen.
-Fixed the issue where the selected item disappears when purchasing an Upgrade Scroll.
-The color problem on the display screen according to the Upgrade rate of the items has been fixed.
- Sorting and display changes were made on the menu screens.

notes.title: A Little More Innovation, A Little More Fix
notes.notes:
-Added +7 and +8 items to drops. These unique items come with the name "Higher".
-Edit Fixed the error that the stats of the items were displayed at different rates from the Options.
-Edit The Stat Rates of Items have been increased.
-Added some sound notifications.
-Fixed the issue where the item info in the Loot Inventory was not displayed.
-Slightly increased the Successful Upgrade Rate in Quick Upgrade.
-Upgrade Bar Color Transition Renewed.

notes.title: Farm System Has Arrived
notes.notes:
-Farm system has arrived. Now You Will Kill Mobs Automatically and you will get Exp, Coins and Loot according to your Soldier's Level. You will compare your soldiers with mobs as you wish, without level limit in mobs.

-Exp amount from quests has been increased.

-Quest mobs' power has been slightly increased.

-Multiple Upgrade Screen Fixed.

-Multiple Upgrade Bar Speed has been increased.

- Changes have been made to the interface.

-Cheat option has been added to the main menu. You will not be able to open cheats in the game unless this option is active from the main menu.

-The errors in coloring your items according to their upgrade rates have been fixed. The color scheme has been changed.

notes.title: Fixed Bugs, Completion of Missing Innovations
notes.notes:
-Items are now divided into Colors by Item + Grade in the Display.
-Fast Item Transfer from Bank to Inventory, From Inventory to Bank Completed.
-Improved the UI of the Edit Item Creation Panel.
-The Features of Items in Edit Item Creation have been increased.
-Fixed the Problems in Activating Cheat. (The 'Enter' Key Also Becomes Working.)
-Fixed your Soldier's 'Already on Mission' Error.
-The problem of deleting your remaining items on the Upgrade screen when exiting the game has been partially fixed.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
-Multiple Upgrade System Added. (A second panel has been added to the game where you can quickly upgrade +3 or +5) *[If you press the Fast Upgrade button at the top right of the Upgrade Panel, you can open the Multiple Upgrade Panel.]*
-Number of Bank Slots Increased.
-Added Graphic Quality Setting
-Added Putting Items in the Bank with Right Click of the Mouse.
-The Way to Activate the Cheat has been shown, but if you do this, you will have the (Cheat Activated) text fixed on your screen!
-Chest Info Display Changed.
-Fixed your Soldier's Mission Stay Error after Dungeon.
-Added Direct Exit from Game Screen to Desktop.
-Changes have been made to the Versus system.
-Various changes have been made to the interface.
-Added new alert sounds and logs.
-The required number of empty slots in your inventory to be able to upgrade has been reduced to 3.

notes.title: "Lucky Stone Disappearing" Error Fixed
notes.notes:
-Errors in placing items with Right Mouse Button have been fixed.
-Item Disappearance Errors Fixed.

notes.title: Unfinished Issues
notes.notes:
-When the Upgrade section is open, you can automatically place the Scrolls and Lucky Stones with the Right Button of the Mouse.
-Added Voice Alerts.
-New Alerts Added to Log.
-Minor Changes Made in the Interface.

notes.title: Indicators and Upgrades
notes.notes:
-Item upgrade rates were changed and categorized according to the item.
-Item Info indicator was Changed.
-Item indicator mouse position scaling was rebuilt.

notes.title: Increased Number of Inventory Slots!
notes.notes:
-Increased the Number of Player Inventory Slots to 24.
-Upgrade Interface Visually Changed.
-Audible Alerts Have Been Added to the Player Item Creator Section.

notes.title: The Mode to Create Your Own Items Has Arrived!
notes.notes: -Now you will be able to Create Your Own Items and create items with the Picture and Name you want. You will be able to Upgrade and Use these items.

notes.title: Mini Fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed the problem of money falling into negative balance when buying bait.
- Fixed item indicator position issue when Upgrade 'Preview'.

notes.title: Name Change Arrived for Soldiers!
notes.notes:
-Now you can change the name of your soldiers as you want!
( 'Name Change' Button Has Been Put in Your Soldier's Slot Section in Military Section. By clicking this button, you will be able to give your Soldier the name you want in exchange for 1 Dungeon Key! )

-Fixed the reaction time in fishing. Timer speed synced.

notes.title: Fishing System Arrived!
notes.notes:
- Fishing System Arrived!
- By Clicking the Fishing Button, you can buy 100 fish baits and start fishing!
- With these fish, you can get items or win Dungeon Keys!
- Changes have been made in the interface.
- Sound fixes made.
- Spelling errors fixed.

notes.title: Some Conveniences, Some Difficulties
notes.notes:
-Event System Desired Level Limit has been reduced to 15!
-Event System Time has been shortened!
-Some minor changes were made in the interface!

notes.title: Craft Fixes 2
notes.notes:
-Salary Loop Saving has been done.
-Fixed the issue of paying a salary to start the craft every time you log into the game.
-Production Loop Coins gain has been increased.
-Crafting Loop Time has been shortened.
- Fixed some typos.
-Fixed the Loop 0 error when you click the Fired Button on the Craft screen.

notes.title: Craft System Fixes
notes.notes:
-The problem of not receiving money in Worker Purchases has been prevented.
-Production time has been shortened. Increased overall earnings within the pay cycle.
-The probability of dropping higher items has been reduced.

notes.title: JOINT BANK OPENED!
notes.notes:
-Joint Bank was established! Now you can share your items with your other characters!
-Bank load problem has been fixed.
-Extra posts have been removed.

notes.title: CRAFT SYSTEM ARRIVED!
notes.notes:
-Craft System Arrived!
[As an Idle, you will be able to earn game money! With the Craft Materials accumulated during this time, you will be able to make your items Better or wearable for New Soldiers!
Master Item: +2 stat bonus + 1000 coins sales price increases!
Low Grade Item: level 1 becomes wearable but -2 stat bonus drops !]

-Event System Reward Increased and Time Shortened,
-Changes have been made to the interface,
-Fixed Spelling Errors,
-Item Balance Adjusted.

notes.title: A Little Bit Better
notes.notes:
-Resolution change has been adjusted.
-Dashboards have been adjusted.
-Some bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Character Selection Edits
notes.notes:
-Character Selection Screen has been adjusted.
-Character Information has been adjusted to show in Character Selection. (the information may be '0' in the first entry, this will be one time only.)

notes.title: Interface bugs fixed
notes.notes:
- Removed unnecessary images.
- Errors appearing in the interface have been fixed.

notes.title: Dungeon System Arrived!
notes.notes:
-Dungeon System Arrived! Dungeons that you can enter with 3 Dungeon Keys, 1 piece of 30 lvl Soldier, 5000 coins. It will open the way for you to win scrolls.

- Added 'Gift' feature. With some updates, various gifts will be given to you, valuable players.

- Minor changes have been made to the interfaces.

notes.title: Preliminary Preparations Part - 1
notes.notes:
- Fixes in Game Saves.
- Soldier's Exp. The indicator has been renewed.
- Event System made minor changes.
- Added Dungeon Key reward to Event System.
- Added 'Dungeon Key' unit. I'll be posting what you can use these keys for soon.

notes.title: A harbinger of new upcoming content
notes.notes:
-Added 1 new item.
-Added 1 new Quest Creature.
-Made some changes to the Quest Balance.
-"Announcements" section has been added to the Main Menu.

Note: The reason the game's file size has increased is because it contains the new content I'm working on. If I can make enough progress, I will announce this content.

notes.title: Balance and Some Speed Update
notes.notes:
-The power of some items has been balanced.
-Event System has been slightly accelerated.

notes.title: Event System Added!
notes.notes:
-You Can Get More Items By Putting Your Level 30 Soldiers Into Events!
-Some Items Incompatibilities Fixed!

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.notes: - Fixed some of the items' problems.
